title: 第14章 开导香菜，丸子贴身“开大”！
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【叮！检测到宿主帮助精神小妹‘丸子’打脸精神小伙‘赵子坤’，获得10000元奖励！】

【奖励已发放至宿主名下xx银行储蓄卡，请注意查收！】

随着机械声消失，江辰立即查看手机流水。

除了10000元系统奖励外，就连刚刚转账给狗坤的那1000元，也获得了返还！

换言之，他只是动动手，转个账。

净赚10000元！

个人存款，也因此来到了4万！

江辰心中不由一喜：

“打脸精神小伙，白拿10000，这系统还怪好的嘞！”

就在这时，丸子手机猛然一震。

扫了一眼，是赵子坤发来的语音消息。

“丸子，刚刚是我有眼不识泰山，请你别和我一般见识。我为我刚才的鲁莽，向你致以最崇高的歉意！”

“另外，那个能不能帮忙介绍一下，你也知道我这个人喜欢到处结交朋友，这不，也想好好认识一下你身旁的那位大哥……”

闻言，丸子冷哼一声，语音回复道：

“啊呸，就你这种坏狗，也配认识江哥？白日做梦吧你！”

说完这话，她看向江辰，一脸感激道：

“哥，刚刚谢谢了……”

说着，整个人就朝江辰扑了过去，欲要贴脸送上两波“福利”。

见状，江辰连忙侧身一躲。

丸子扑了个空，倒在床上，臀部翘起一个挺拔的弧度。

“时候不早了，都给我洗澡去。”江辰近乎命令的口吻，说道。

“噢耶，洗澡去咯！人生第一次泡浴缸！”香菜一脸雀跃道。

赵安妮眼前也是一亮，一脸兴奋道：

“躺在总统套房的浴缸里，美美地泡上一个热水澡！别提有多惬意了！”

下一秒，江辰瞳孔猛然收缩。

连忙开口：“喂，你，你们注意点啊！当我不存在是吧？”

江辰万万没想到，三个精神小妹是一点不拿他当外人啊。

这不，脱衣服都不选个隐蔽的地方。

主打一个肥水不流外人田！

赵安妮一只脚轻轻踩在床边，美腿白皙而又修长，关键还套了诱惑力极强的黑丝！

就在这时，她微微侧头，朝江辰抛来一个媚眼。

不得不说，角度找得太绝了！

“哥，你是正经人，肯定不会偷看的，对吧？”她的语气充满了挑逗的意味。

“咳咳……”

江辰连忙扭头。

眼不见，心为净。

否则，怕是要忍不住积极向上了。

不一会儿。

洗浴间内，就传出了三个小妹的嬉戏打闹声。

江辰果断

哎，看着那扇没关的洗浴门，天知道他忍得有多难受啊……

Page (1/3)

[Ding!It was detected that the host helped the spirited girl ‘Wanzi’ slap the spirited boy ‘Zhao Zikun’ in the face, and received a reward of 10,000 yuan!】

[The reward has been distributed to the xx bank savings card in the name of the host, please check it carefully!】

As the mechanical sound disappeared, Jiang Chen immediately checked the water flow on his phone.

In addition to the 10,000 yuan system reward, even the 1,000 yuan just transferred to Gou Kun was also returned!

In other words, he just moved his hands and transferred money.

Net profit of 10,000 yuan!

As a result, my personal savings reached 40,000!

Jiang Chen couldn't help but feel happy:

"You slapped this young guy in the face and got 10,000 for nothing. This system is so good!"

At this moment, Wanzi's phone vibrated suddenly.

After glancing at it, it was a voice message from Zhao Zikun.

"Wanzi, I just couldn't see Taishan. Please don't be the same as me. I offer you my highest apology for my recklessness just now!"

"Also, can you help me introduce you? You also know that I like to make friends everywhere. No, I also want to get to know the big brother next to you..."

Hearing this, Wanzi snorted coldly and replied with a voice:

"Ah, a bad dog like you deserves to know Brother Jiang? Just daydream!"

After saying this, she looked at Jiang Chen and said with gratitude:

"Brother, thank you just now..."

After saying that, he rushed towards Jiang Chen, trying to send two waves of "welfare" to his face.

Seeing this, Jiang Chen quickly turned sideways and hid.

The ball was thrown away and fell on the bed, with his hips raised in a straight arc.

"It's getting late, please go take a bath for me." Jiang Chen said in an almost commanding tone.

"Oh yeah, let's go take a bath! It's my first time in the bathtub in my life!" Xiangcai said with excitement on her face.

Zhao Anni's eyes also lit up, and she said excitedly:

"Lie in the bathtub of the presidential suite and take a nice hot bath! Not to mention how comfortable it is!"

The next second, Jiang Chen's pupils suddenly shrank.

He quickly said: "Hey, you, please pay attention! Pretend that I don't exist, right?"

Jiang Chen never expected that the three spirited girls would not regard him as an outsider at all.

No, I didn’t even choose a secluded place to take off my clothes.

The main goal is to keep the wealth from going to outsiders!

Zhao Anni stepped lightly on the edge of the bed with one foot. Her beautiful legs were white and slender, and the key point was that she was wearing very attractive black stockings!

At this moment, she turned her head slightly and cast a flirtatious look at Jiang Chen.

I have to say, the angle is amazing!

"Brother, you are a serious person, you will definitely not peek, right?" Her tone was full of provocation.

"Ahem..."

Jiang Chen quickly turned his head.

Out of sight, the mind is pure.

Otherwise, I'm afraid I won't be able to help but be positive.

Soon.

In the bathroom, the sound of three young girls playing and playing could be heard.

Jiang Chen is decisive

Hey, looking at the open bathroom door, God knows how uncomfortable he endured...
